name: Crimson
storyline:
Evelyn Chandler, recently heart-broken woman, has to explore and fight her way though Count Dracula’s hellish church alongside her sturdy chainsaw known as "The Bloody Mary". Before the sun rises again, she must make her way to the top to face off against Dracula himself and discovers why everyone has been disappearing.

After a night of yelling and arguments, 23 year old Evelyn Chandler gets her heart broken by her, now ex-boyfriend, Tim Sloan. Meanwhile, across Massachusetts, people have begun disappearing without a trace; including Tim. Sightings of vampiric beasts plague the area, with nobody truly able to understand who, or what, is causing them. It is now up to one depressed and aggrivated Evelyn (alongside her best friend Babe Manners) uncover the truth behind the murders and face off against Count Dracula himself.
summary:
Crimson is a violent, gothic, roguelike, action-horror game all about a church arising out of Hell, and a heartbroken woman named Evelyn Chandler venturing inside to kill Count Dracula and his family. This is a blood-filled war out of love, revenge, and hunger.

Evelyn Chandler, recently heart-broken woman, has to explore and fight her way though "The Church of The Bloodthirsty" alongside her sturdy chainsaw-pistol known as "The Bloody Mary" (put together by her friend Babe Manners). Before the sun rises again, she must make her way to the top to face off against Dracula himself and discovers why everyone has been disappearing.

Try not to drown in the blood of the innocent as Evelyn and The Impaler go toe-to-toe in CRIMSON: THE GAME OF BLOOD
